source_verdict_note: ENLEX READY is an editorial proposed gloss, not complete teaching certification and not Muse approval

records.gloss_en: an activity done regularly for pleasure in spare time
records.collocation: take up a hobby · favorite hobby · pursue a hobby
records.example_en: Gardening is her favorite hobby.
records.example_zh: 园艺是她最喜欢的业余爱好。
records.grammar_note: hobby为可数名词，复数hobbies。
records.contrast_note: hobby通常指闲暇时间出于兴趣开展的活动；occupation通常表示职业或日常主要工作。
records.editorial_reason: Gardening as a leisure pursuit demonstrates enjoyment in spare time.

records.gloss_en: not final or definite and possibly subject to change
records.collocation: tentative plan · tentative agreement · tentative date
records.example_en: We made a tentative plan for the weekend.
records.example_zh: 我们初步拟定了周末的计划。
records.grammar_note: tentative常作定语，说明计划或决定尚未最终确定。
records.contrast_note: tentative表示暂时性、仍可能调整；final意味着已经确定。
records.editorial_reason: Plan may be revised; this is not the hesitant manner of physical movement.

records.gloss_zh: 非常艰苦的；使人筋疲力尽的
records.gloss_en: extremely tiring and requiring sustained effort
records.collocation: grueling schedule · grueling workout · grueling journey
records.example_en: The team finished a grueling training session.
records.example_zh: 队员们完成了一次令人筋疲力尽的训练。
records.grammar_note: grueling为形容词，修饰体力或精神负担很重的活动。
records.contrast_note: grueling强调过程艰苦且让人疲惫；long只表示持续时间长，不一定艰苦。
records.editorial_reason: Training that exhausts participants matches physically demanding experience.

records.gloss_en: continuing without stopping or making an intermediate stop
records.collocation: nonstop flight · nonstop service · work nonstop
records.example_en: We booked a nonstop flight to Tokyo.
records.example_zh: 我们预订了直飞东京的航班。
records.grammar_note: nonstop作形容词时置于名词前；作副词可修饰动词。
records.contrast_note: nonstop flight强调途中不停靠；direct flight有时允许中途停靠，须看航班实际定义。
records.editorial_reason: Nonstop routes are defined by no intermediate stop; contrast does not guarantee travel time.

records.gloss_en: material made of intersecting wires or threads with openings
records.collocation: fine mesh · wire mesh · mesh screen
records.example_en: The window has a fine mesh to keep insects out.
records.example_zh: 窗户装有细密的纱网，用来阻挡昆虫。
records.grammar_note: mesh指网状材料时可作不可数名词，也可指一片网。
records.contrast_note: mesh是有孔的网状结构；solid sheet是不带孔的整片材料。
records.editorial_reason: Window insect screen is an unambiguous physical mesh application.

records.gloss_en: a student or beginner receiving supervised practical work experience
records.collocation: summer intern · paid intern · hire an intern
records.example_en: She works as an intern at a design studio.
records.example_zh: 她在一家设计工作室实习。
records.grammar_note: intern为可数名词，复数interns；可作动词表示实习。
records.contrast_note: intern通常指接受实践训练的实习人员；employee是更泛的雇员称谓，二者可能重叠。
records.editorial_reason: Intern as workplace trainee is clear; does not presume unpaid status.

records.gloss_en: an introduction placed at the beginning of a book
records.collocation: write a preface · book preface · preface to the book
records.example_en: The author explains her purpose in the preface.
records.example_zh: 作者在前言中说明了写作目的。
records.grammar_note: preface为可数名词，常说the preface to a book。
records.contrast_note: preface是书的前言；appendix是附在书末的补充材料。
records.editorial_reason: Book front matter with authorial motivation illustrates the noun.

records.gloss_en: the ability to continue without using up essential resources or causing excessive harm
records.collocation: environmental sustainability · long-term sustainability · sustainability goals
records.example_en: The company is reviewing the sustainability of its packaging.
records.example_zh: 这家公司正在评估其包装的可持续性。
records.grammar_note: sustainability通常为不可数名词。
records.contrast_note: sustainability强调长期可维持性；short-term profit只关注短期收益。
records.editorial_reason: Packaging context focuses on long-term effects rather than making an unsupported green claim.

records.gloss_en: an open public square in a city or town
records.collocation: public plaza · town plaza · shopping plaza
records.example_en: People gathered in the plaza for the concert.
records.example_zh: 人们聚集在广场上参加音乐会。
records.grammar_note: plaza为可数名词，复数plazas。
records.contrast_note: plaza通常指开放广场，也可见于购物商业区名称；square也可指城市广场。
records.editorial_reason: An open communal space hosting concert is natural.

records.gloss_en: able to speak or write a language smoothly and easily
records.collocation: fluent English · fluent speaker · become fluent
records.example_en: She became fluent in Spanish after years of practice.
records.example_zh: 经过多年练习，她能流利地说西班牙语了。
records.grammar_note: 常用be fluent in a language结构。
records.contrast_note: fluent强调表达自然流畅；accurate强调准确性，两者相关但不等同。
records.editorial_reason: Language fluency described without assuming native accent or flawless grammar.

records.gloss_en: a person who has only recently begun learning a skill or activity
records.collocation: complete beginner · beginner course · suitable for beginners
records.example_en: This course is designed for beginners.
records.example_zh: 这门课程是为初学者设计的。
records.grammar_note: beginner可数，复数beginners；beginner course为名词作定语。
records.contrast_note: beginner是刚开始学习的人；expert表示在领域中具有深厚知识或技能的人。
records.editorial_reason: Introductory course fits learner with little experience.

records.gloss_en: relating to electricity or equipment operated using electricity
records.collocation: electrical equipment · electrical wiring · electrical fault
records.example_en: The technician repaired an electrical fault.
records.example_zh: 技术人员修复了一处电气故障。
records.grammar_note: electrical为形容词，通常置于名词前。
records.contrast_note: electrical偏向与电力系统、设备相关；electronic偏向电子电路和电子器件。
records.editorial_reason: Electrical wiring/equipment context distinguishes broad power from electronics.

records.gloss_en: happening at a useful or appropriate time
records.collocation: timely reminder · timely response · timely intervention
records.example_en: Your timely reminder helped us meet the deadline.
records.example_zh: 你及时的提醒帮助我们赶上了截止期限。
records.grammar_note: timely为形容词，常作名词前定语。
records.contrast_note: timely强调在恰当或需要的时机发生；fast只表示速度快。
records.editorial_reason: Reminder at useful time provides clear practical value.

records.gloss_en: a worker who receives payments from customers
records.collocation: cashier at a store · supermarket cashier · pay the cashier
records.example_en: The cashier gave me a receipt after I paid.
records.example_zh: 我付款后，收银员给了我一张收据。
records.grammar_note: cashier为可数名词，复数cashiers。
records.contrast_note: cashier负责收取款项；customer是购物或接受服务的顾客。
records.editorial_reason: Payment and receipt are typical cashier interactions.

records.gloss_en: a place offering treatments for health or relaxation
records.collocation: spa treatment · spa hotel · visit a spa
records.example_en: We booked a spa treatment for Saturday.
records.example_zh: 我们预订了周六的水疗护理。
records.grammar_note: spa作为可数名词，复数spas。
records.contrast_note: spa通常提供休闲或身体护理服务；hospital主要提供医疗诊治，不能混为一谈。
records.editorial_reason: Booking a treatment clearly maps to relaxation/wellness spa sense.

records.gloss_en: a facility where patients get medical consultation or treatment, usually without an overnight stay
records.collocation: medical clinic · local clinic · visit a clinic
records.example_en: She made an appointment at the local clinic.
records.example_zh: 她在当地诊所预约了就诊。
records.grammar_note: clinic为可数名词，复数clinics。
records.contrast_note: clinic一般提供门诊服务；hospital常有更广泛的医疗设施，但机构规模并无绝对界限。
records.editorial_reason: Outpatient booking is representative and does not prescribe care.

records.gloss_en: a light enclosed in a protective case, often carried or hung
records.collocation: paper lantern · carry a lantern · lantern light
records.example_en: They hung paper lanterns outside the house.
records.example_zh: 他们在屋外挂起了纸灯笼。
records.grammar_note: lantern为可数名词，复数lanterns。
records.contrast_note: lantern是带有外罩的可携带或悬挂的照明器具；lamp范围更广。
records.editorial_reason: Traditional paper lantern is a straightforward count noun.

records.gloss_en: to change a product or service to fit a particular user's needs
records.collocation: customize the settings · customize a product · customizable options
records.example_en: You can customize the display settings.
records.example_zh: 你可以自定义显示设置。
records.grammar_note: customize为及物动词；customized是其过去式或形容词。
records.contrast_note: customize按需要调整具体功能或形式；personalize通常强调针对某个人的偏好。
records.editorial_reason: Display preference is a natural customizable attribute.

records.gloss_en: a small computer designed to be carried and used in different places
records.collocation: laptop computer · laptop screen · carry a laptop
records.example_en: I left my laptop on the desk.
records.example_zh: 我把笔记本电脑放在了书桌上。
records.grammar_note: laptop为可数名词，复数laptops。
records.contrast_note: laptop通常是便携式电脑；desktop computer通常设计为固定在桌面使用。
records.editorial_reason: Everyday object and spatial placement directly illustrate noun.

records.gloss_en: the state of not being watched or disturbed by others without permission
records.collocation: protect privacy · privacy settings · personal privacy
records.example_en: The app lets users adjust their privacy settings.
records.example_zh: 这个应用允许用户调整隐私设置。
records.grammar_note: privacy通常作不可数名词。
records.contrast_note: privacy是控制个人信息或私人生活被访问的权利或状态；security更偏防止未授权访问或伤害。
records.editorial_reason: Privacy controls illustrative rather than asserting privacy settings guarantee security.
